1.title: Task 1: Create all student, faculty, course, and department nodes with properties
1.description: Verifies that all 5 Student, 2 Faculty, 5 Course, and 2 Department nodes (Total 14 nodes) were created with their given properties.
1.query: MATCH (n) RETURN labels(n)[0] AS Label, count(n) AS CreatedCount ORDER BY Label;

2.title: Task 2: Create all specified relationships with their appropriate directions
2.description: Verifies creation and directions of all 26 relationships (11 ENROLLED_IN, 5 TEACHES, 5 BELONGS_TO, 5 OFFERS).
2.query: MATCH (a)-[r]->(b) RETURN labels(a)[0] AS Source, type(r) AS Relationship, labels(b)[0] AS Target, count(r) AS Count ORDER BY Relationship;

3.title: Task 3: Assign properties to the ENROLLED_IN and TEACHES relationships
3.description: Verifies relationship properties (semesterEnrolled, grade on ENROLLED_IN and academicYear on TEACHES).
3.query: MATCH ()-[r:ENROLLED_IN]->() RETURN DISTINCT r.semesterEnrolled AS SemesterEnrolled, r.grade AS Grade UNION ALL MATCH ()-[r2:TEACHES]->() RETURN DISTINCT r2.academicYear AS SemesterEnrolled, 'N/A' AS Grade;

4.title: Task 4: Display the complete graph
4.description: Returns all nodes and directed relationships forming the complete university graph.
4.query: MATCH (n) OPTIONAL MATCH (n)-[r]->(m) RETURN count(DISTINCT n) AS TotalNodes, count(r) AS TotalRelationships;

5.title: Task 5: Count the number of nodes belonging to each label
5.description: Counts nodes grouped by label (Course: 5, Department: 2, Faculty: 2, Student: 5).
5.query: MATCH (n) RETURN labels(n)[0] AS Label, count(n) AS NodeCount ORDER BY Label;

6.title: Task 6: Display all relationship types and verify their directions
6.description: Confirms source and target labels for all 4 relationship types to verify directionality.
6.query: MATCH (a)-[r]->(b) RETURN labels(a)[0] AS SourceNode, type(r) AS RelationshipType, labels(b)[0] AS TargetNode, count(r) AS Count ORDER BY RelationshipType, SourceNode;

7.title: Task 7: Retrieve all students studying in Semester 5
7.description: Filters students who are in semester 5 (Aarav Sharma, Priya Das, Arjun Patel).
7.query: MATCH (s:Student) WHERE s.semester = 5 RETURN s.studentId AS StudentID, s.name AS Name, s.semester AS Semester, s.email AS Email ORDER BY s.studentId;

8.title: Task 8: Find all courses with more than 3 credits
8.description: Filters courses with credits > 3 (CS302 DBMS: 4, CS304 Big Data Analytics: 4).
8.query: MATCH (c:Course) WHERE c.credits > 3 RETURN c.courseCode AS CourseCode, c.courseTitle AS CourseTitle, c.credits AS Credits, c.level AS Level ORDER BY c.courseCode;

9.title: Task 9: Retrieve the courses taught by Dr. Meera Sen
9.description: Retrieves courses taught by Dr. Meera Sen (CS302 DBMS, CS305 NoSQL Databases).
9.query: MATCH (f:Faculty {name: 'Dr. Meera Sen'})-[r:TEACHES]->(c:Course) RETURN f.name AS FacultyName, c.courseCode AS CourseCode, c.courseTitle AS CourseTitle, c.credits AS Credits, r.academicYear AS AcademicYear ORDER BY c.courseCode;

10.title: Task 10: Find all students enrolled in Graph Analytics
10.description: Finds all students enrolled in CS301 Graph Analytics (Aarav Sharma, Priya Das, Arjun Patel).
10.query: MATCH (s:Student)-[r:ENROLLED_IN]->(c:Course) WHERE c.courseTitle = 'Graph Analytics' RETURN s.studentId AS StudentID, s.name AS StudentName, s.semester AS CurrentSemester, c.courseTitle AS EnrolledCourse ORDER BY s.studentId;

11.title: Task 11: Display the names of all students belonging to the Computer Science department
11.description: Lists students belonging to CS department (Aarav Sharma, Priya Das, Rahul Verma).
11.query: MATCH (s:Student)-[:BELONGS_TO]->(d:Department) WHERE d.deptName = 'Computer Science' RETURN s.studentId AS StudentID, s.name AS StudentName, d.deptName AS DepartmentName, d.building AS Building ORDER BY s.studentId;

12.title: Task 12: Find all courses offered by the Information Technology department
12.description: Lists courses offered by IT department (CS301 Graph Analytics, CS304 Big Data Analytics).
12.query: MATCH (d:Department)-[:OFFERS]->(c:Course) WHERE d.deptName = 'Information Technology' RETURN d.deptName AS DepartmentName, c.courseCode AS CourseCode, c.courseTitle AS CourseTitle, c.credits AS Credits, c.level AS Level ORDER BY c.courseCode;

13.title: Task 13: Retrieve all students enrolled in NoSQL Databases along with their semester and grade
13.description: Retrieves students in CS305 NoSQL Databases with enrollment semester and grade (Aarav Sharma: Sem 5, Sneha Roy: Sem 3).
13.query: MATCH (s:Student)-[r:ENROLLED_IN]->(c:Course) WHERE c.courseTitle = 'NoSQL Databases' RETURN s.studentId AS StudentID, s.name AS StudentName, s.semester AS StudentSemester, r.semesterEnrolled AS SemesterEnrolled, r.grade AS Grade, c.courseTitle AS CourseTitle ORDER BY s.studentId;

14.title: Task 14: Find all students enrolled in both Graph Analytics and another course
14.description: Retrieves students enrolled in Graph Analytics who are also taking at least one other course.
14.query: MATCH (s:Student)-[:ENROLLED_IN]->(c1:Course {courseTitle: 'Graph Analytics'}), (s)-[:ENROLLED_IN]->(c2:Course) WHERE c1 <> c2 RETURN s.studentId AS StudentID, s.name AS StudentName, c1.courseTitle AS PrimaryCourse, c2.courseTitle AS OtherCourse ORDER BY s.studentId, c2.courseTitle;
